notes:
Account focused on massive-scale semantic search + reranking. Primary ask: operational plan and unit-cost model for 100M -> 1B+ vectors. Wants a hybrid architecture: local ANN (HNSW/IVF) for candidate recall + cross-encoder reranker on GPU for top-10. SLOs: p95 query latency target <50ms for tail when reranking turned on (best-effort), ~10-30ms for ANN-only. Cost target: <$0.001/query average across blended traffic; POC to validate batching/caching and quantized model throughput. Data residency: EU for subset of customers, want KMS + audit logs. Security: will submit full security questionnaire (SAML, SOC2 attestation required).

POC scope (agreed): 1) Ingest 500M vectors (subset of customers) -> measure indexing throughput and storage; 2) Benchmark ANN recall + latency on dedicated GPU pool; 3) Add cross-encoder reranker for top-10; 4) Run 1M queries/day simulated to run cost model.

Notes from discovery call: 'We need a predictable unit cost model before committing to reserved capacity' - CTO. Ops lead very concerned about burst capacity and cold-cache costs. They asked about on-prem install path and upgrade cadence. SE asks: provide sample autoscaling policies and recommended batch sizes for quantized 8-bit cross-encoder.

Current infra: Mix of Elasticsearch for metadata + custom blob store (S3-compatible). Wants compatibility with existing ES routing for failover. Mentioned evaluating internal ANN first but open to Redwood routing and fallbacks to cheaper embeddings models during peak.

requirements_summary:
Massive indexing: target 500M->1B+ vectors initially. High ingest throughput (50-200k vectors/min target), stable ANN recall > 92% at 10K candidates, latency SLOs: ANN-only 10-30ms p95, ANN+rerank 40-80ms p95 depending on batch. Needs predictive cost model with per-query breakdown (ANN cost, reranker GPU cost, storage). Wants autoscaling guidance, KV/prefix caching to reduce tail cost, and batching guidance for cross-encoder throughput. Support for quantized embeddings and GPU-backed re-ranker (FP16/INT8).

Non-functional: EU data residency for subset, SSO/SAML, KMS integration, audit logs/retention 7+ years for specific clients. Must support private deployment (VPC or on-prem) for regulated customers.
